### The Best I Can
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-january-24-2024.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 28:9-10
Points:
- David accepted God saying no to his personal dream of building the temple, choosing instead to focus on what God permitted him to do.
- Growing in faith often involves relinquishing cherished ambitions or long-held expectations.
- Turning attention toward God's past faithfulness protects believers from bitterness and regret in later years.
- Believers can find peace by doing their best with what God provides and trusting Him to use it for His glory.

### Day 83: 1 Chronicles 28:1–10
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-83-1-chronicles-28-110.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 28:9
Points:
- David gave Solomon three vital directives essential for true spiritual and life success.
- Beginning each day by intentionally acknowledging God's authority guards against stumbling into self-reliance.
- God calls for wholehearted devotion, symbolized by unhewn stones with undivided allegiance.
- Faithful service must stem from genuine delight in God rather than forced religious duty.
- When facing a divided heart, believers should ask God to transform and renew their inner desires.
